fields.description: Ocean House brings apartments, duplexes and larger signature residences to Palm Jumeirah’s Crescent. Curved balconies and distinct single- or dual-aspect layouts shape the homes, while shared wellness, fitness and social spaces are arranged around the building’s seafront setting.

overview: The signature plans distinguish a six-bedroom presidential suite from a five-bedroom corner penthouse. Duplex totals cover both levels, rather than an area to repeat for each floor.
research.locationNote: Palm Jumeirah, The Crescent, Dubai. Views and access rights depend on the actual residence and agreement.

research.priceNote: Property Finder’s launch hero rounds pricing to AED 23 million. This is a marketing reference for the listed mix, not a current developer quotation or the cost of every two-bedroom home.
research.paymentNote: The official microsite ends with 40% on completion; Property Finder instead lists 20/50/30. These schedules conflict; the table preserves the developer reference without asserting current contract terms.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder’s structured field targets December 2026, while its body gives Q1 2026. These inconsistent forecasts do not establish a binding handover or actual completion.
unresolved: The developer brochure prints 1,926.95 ft² under the 3BR corner plan; the partner presentation gives 3,531.96 ft² for that drawing. Confirm the selected schedule. Minor rounding differences are retained.
Current availability, contractual dates and payment, approved charges, parking/title terms, furnishing inventory and facility operation require confirmation. Images remain illustrative.
